Question 2

```{r}
n <- 800000  # number of simulations
set.seed(1)
X <- runif(n)  # simulating from U[0,1]
Y <- X - X^2

# theoretical density function for Y
f_Y <- function(y) {
  ifelse(y >= 0 & y < 0.25, 2 / sqrt(1 - 4*y), 0)
}

y_vals <- seq(0, 0.25, length.out = 1000)
density_vals <- sapply(y_vals, f_Y)

# Plotting
hist(Y, probability=TRUE, breaks=200, main="Density of Y", xlab="y", ylab="Density", ylim=c(0, max(density_vals)))
lines(y_vals, density_vals, col="red", lwd=1)
```

```{r}
y_vals <- seq(-0.25, 0.25, by=0.0001)
cdf_Y <- sapply(y_vals, function(y) mean(Y <= y))

plot(y_vals, cdf_Y, type="l", xlab="y", ylab="CDF", main="CDF of Y")
```


```{r}
median(Y)

mean(Y)
3/16
```

Question 3

```{r}
p <- 0.3889798877867867  # Let's assume some value for p. You can change it.
j_values <- 0:800000
probabilities <- (1-p) * p^j_values
sum(probabilities)  # Should be very close to 1 if our sum converges for this large value of j

# Calculate probabilities for Y
prob_Y_is_1 <- sum(probabilities[j_values %% 2 == 0])  # X is even
prob_Y_is_minus_1 <- sum(probabilities[j_values %% 2 == 1])  # X is odd

prob_Y_is_1  # Prob(Y = 1)
prob_Y_is_minus_1  # Prob(Y = -1)

1/(1+p)
p/(1+p)
```
```{r}
numerator <- sum(j_values[j_values %% 2 == 0] * probabilities[j_values %% 2 == 0])
denominator <- prob_Y_is_1
expected_value_X_given_Y_1 <- numerator / denominator
expected_value_X_given_Y_1
2*p^2/(1-p^2)
```
